messages:
marie: EOQ release freeze update: extending freeze 48h to deploy a critical kernel patch to parts of the GPU fleet. We saw a canary RPS spike causing transient OOMs on embeddings in canary-2. Hold non-urgent deploys.

devon: Which clusters are impacted?

marie: A subset of model-router + gpu-fleet nodes in us-west. Canary-2 is the noisy group.

gina: Confirming 3/5 failed canaries on canary-2. Logs point to KV cache thrash -> memory pressure. I paused canary promotions.

release-bot: canary-2 paused by gina at 2025-11-04T09:40Z.

samir: Plan: patch one canary node, monitor 30-60m, then stagger. @ops-oncall will run validation checklist.

ops-oncall: Patch started on first node. ETA for initial observation: ~40m. Will post metric snapshots here.

marie: Exception process if you must ship during freeze:
```
/permit-deploy EOQ-KERNEL --pr <URL> --reason "urgent prod OOM fix"
```
Approvers: eng-sre lead + release manager. Include rollback plan + smoke tests.

devon: Can we throttle embeddings route to reduce pressure on canary-2?

gina: Yes. Throttle /v1/embed and search-reorder for canary-2. Suggest soft-limit ~20 rps/token and reduce client batching.

marie: Runbook updated (internal). Freeze now ends Mon 15:00 UTC, auto-unfreeze disabled.

release-bot: Freeze extended 48h. New unfreeze: Mon 15:00 UTC. Auto-unfreeze: OFF.

ops-oncall: First node patched, 30m observation shows no OOMs and stable CPU. Proceeding with staggered roll (3 nodes, 20m intervals).

gina: Re-enable expansion only after +2h full-roll stability and green smoke tests.

marie: Confirmed. Please escalate regressions in this thread and add a brief note to the postmortem after rollout completes.
